    {
      "Concept ID": "C1",
      "Concept Name": "Instruction-memory contents",
      "Unit": "neorv32_imem",
      "Information": "The information is the application image and 32-bit words stored in the processor-internal instruction memory, on which addressed memory reads depend. In RAM builds, bus write data becomes part of these stored words.",
      "Rubric": {
        "Confidentiality": "yes",
        "Integrity": "yes",
        "Availability": "yes",
        "Undermined Expected Behavior": "no"
      },
      "Rubric Reason": "Yes for confidentiality: the ROM or RAM contents are exposed through the bus response data path at line 185, sourced by the memory reads at lines 81, 95, 128-131 and 159-162. Yes for integrity: byte-enabled bus writes can modify the stored memory contents at lines 116-125 and 145-154. Yes for availability: the memory supplies the required response words, and the read-enable path can withhold them by selecting zero data at lines 176 and 185.",
      "Objectives At Risk": [
        "C",
        "I",
        "A"
      ],
      "Attack": "An unauthorized bus master could read response words to extract the image, overwrite selected RAM bytes with malicious instructions, or keep the read qualification inactive so required responses are withheld.",

        "bus_req_i.data"
      ],
      "Leaves Through": [
        "bus_rsp_o.data"
      ],

      ]
    },
    {
      "Concept ID": "C2",
      "Concept Name": "Memory-read response enable",
      "Unit": "neorv32_imem",
      "Information": "This is the internal registered decision that qualifies whether stored memory data is released on the response. It has no value-carrying entry or exit port because request fields only decide it and it only gates the response data.",
      "Rubric": {
        "Confidentiality": "no",
        "Integrity": "no",
        "Availability": "yes",
        "Undermined Expected Behavior": "no"
      },
      "Rubric Reason": "Yes for availability: rden is set from the request controls at line 176 and gates bus_rsp_o.data to either memory data or zero at line 185, so it can withhold a required memory response.",

  "Not Kept": [
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Memory access address and byte-selection controls",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_imem",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "The address and byte-enable fields select or qualify access to the stored words but are access controls rather than independently protected information, and the access-command rule bars them as separate pieces."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Bus request strobe and read/write direction",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_imem",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "These record fields are access-command information used to perform or qualify a transfer; the only separately judged derived decision is the read-enable asset C2."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Bus response acknowledgement and error",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_imem",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "The acknowledgement only reports or repeats access handshaking and the error output is tied to a constant at line 186, so neither is an independent security asset."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Pipelined access address",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_imem",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "addr_ff only copies and indexes the address for the access in progress at lines 92, 142 and 159-162, so the held-address rule makes it part of the access address rather than a separate piece."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Build-time memory configuration",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_imem",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "IMEM_SIZE and IMEM_INIT only select the implementation and initial image at lines 23-25 and cannot be changed or withheld at run time."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Clock and reset",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_imem",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "clk_i and rstn_i only provide timing and reset behavior at lines 28-29 and 170-176, which the clock/reset rule excludes from conceptual assets."
    }
  ],
  "Notes": [
    "The RTL shows bus_feedback assigning bus_rsp_o.ack directly at lines 174 and 178-180, but the diagram's bus_feedback arrow lists only rden."
  ]
